facts.text: The hotel is located within the walls of Old Québec, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is ideally located within the walls of Old Québec, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

facts.text: The hotel first opened in 1893, commissioned by the Canadian Pacific Railway.
facts.excerpt: The property first opened its doors in 1893 after being commissioned by the Canadian Pacific Railway.

facts.text: Some suites pay homage to Canadian public figures and former hotel guests, such as the Trudeau & Trudeau Suite and the Hitchcock Suite.
facts.excerpt: Certain suites pay homage to relevant Canadian public figures (like the Trudeau & Trudeau Suite) as well as former hotel guests (like the Hitchcock Suite or the Suite Grace de Monaco)

facts.text: The Van Horne Suite includes butler service.
facts.excerpt: Premium suite, Canadian Pacific Railway-inspired decor, master bedroom, luxurious bathtubroom, spacious dining room and living room, views of St. Lawrence River. Includes butler service.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold guests have access to a lounge with complimentary breakfast and evening canapes, and a private check-in and check-out on the 14th floor.
facts.excerpt: Access to a luxurious lounge with complimentary Breakfast and Evening Canapes, private check-in/out on 14th floor

facts.text: The Signature Two Double room has a living room with a sofabed and is described as ideal for families and long-stay guests.
facts.excerpt: Spacious and elegant open space, living room with sofabed, ideal for families and long-stay guests

facts.text: The hotel has four restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: The Château Frontenac boasts four restaurants and bars throughout the property

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served at Place Dufferin on weekends.
facts.excerpt: Weekend afternoon tea at Place Dufferin is also well worth making time for

facts.text: Bar 1608, next to Champlain, is designed to look like a clock paused in time.
facts.excerpt: grab a cocktail at the adjacent 1608 bar which is designed to look like a clock paused in time

facts.text: Champlain is a restaurant with a tasting menu, and tables are not always easy to get, so booking ahead is advised.
facts.excerpt: grabbing a table at Champlain is not always easy, and you’ll definitely want to book ahead

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool with a view of Old Quebec.
facts.excerpt: Yes, the hotel has a heated indoor pool with a spectacular view of Old Quebec.

facts.text: The hotel also has a jacuzzi, a hammam and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: It also has a jacuzzi, a hammam and a sauna you can use to relax.

facts.text: An outdoor terrace just beyond the pool has a small bar and lounge chairs overlooking Old Quebec.
facts.excerpt: There’s a somewhat hidden outdoor terrace area just beyond the pool with a small bar and lounge chairs that overlook some of the prettiest parts of Vieux Quebec

facts.text: The hotel has a spa called Moment Spa Le Château Frontenac.
facts.excerpt: a moment of ultimate relaxation at Moment Spa Le Château Frontenac.

facts.text: The hotel sits at the edge of the Dufferin Terrace.
facts.excerpt: Perched right at the edge of the Dufferin Terrace, the Château Frontenac

facts.text: Because the hotel is in the Upper Town on a cliff, it has a quiet atmosphere at night.
facts.excerpt: its position within the Upper Town (essentially sitting upon a cliff) means that the hotel offers a quiet atmosphere come nighttime

facts.text: Wedding parties are often seen in the lobby, especially on weekends.
facts.excerpt: don’t be surprised to find elegant wedding parties dotting the lobby—especially on weekends

facts.text: Valet parking is available for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee

facts.text: Check-in is from 4:00 p.m. and check-out is until noon.
facts.excerpt: Check-in is from 4:00 p.m. and check-out is until noon.

facts.text: The hotel has a concierge team in the main lobby that can arrange city tours, limousine transportation or restaurant reservations.
facts.excerpt: Yes, the Concierge is located in the main lobby. The concierge team will happily arrange city tours, limousine transportation or restaurant reservations.

facts.text: The hotel is listed in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards for 2017 to 2024 and 2026.
